tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 2, 5], 11) == 3
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([2], 3) == -1
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1], 0) == 0
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1], 1) == 1
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1], 2) == 2
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 3, 4], 6) == 2

tests.description: 小规模：最优解使用大面额
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 5, 10], 18) == 4

tests.description: 小规模：贪心算法会失败
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([3, 7], 14); assert result == 2

tests.description: 小规模：所有硬币都大于amount
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([5, 10, 15], 3) == -1
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 2, 5], 13) == 4
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([5], 20) == 4

tests.description: 小规模：单个硬币无法凑成
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([5], 7) == -1
from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 2, 5], 6); assert result == 2
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 5, 10, 25], 100) == 4
from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([2, 3, 5, 7], 50); assert result > 0 and result <= 50
from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 5, 10, 25, 50], 500); assert result == 10
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([2, 4, 6], 99) == -1

tests.description: 中等规模：最优解需要多个小面额
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 3, 4], 200); assert result > 0
from coin_change import coin_change; coins = [50, 100, 200, 500]; result = coin_change(coins, 950); assert result == 2

from coin_change import coin_change; import time; coins = [1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100]; start = time.time(); result = coin_change(coins, 1000); elapsed = time.time() - start; assert elapsed < 0.5, f'Timeout: took {elapsed}s'; assert result > 0

from coin_change import coin_change; import time; coins = [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500]; start = time.time(); result = coin_change(coins, 5000); elapsed = time.time() - start; assert elapsed < 1.0, f'Timeout: took {elapsed}s'; assert result > 0

from coin_change import coin_change; import time; coins = [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000]; start = time.time(); result = coin_change(coins, 10000); elapsed = time.time() - start; assert elapsed < 1.5, f'Timeout: took {elapsed}s'; assert result == 10

tests.description: 大规模：只有小面额硬币
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; coins = [1, 2, 3]; result = coin_change(coins, 10000); assert result == 3334
from coin_change import coin_change; coins = [1, 9999, 10000]; result = coin_change(coins, 10000); assert result == 1
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1, 2, 5], 0) == 0
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([1], 1) == 1
from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 3, 5], 100); assert result == 20
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([100, 200, 300], 50) == -1
from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([7], 49) == 7

tests.description: 边界：单个硬币，不可整除
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; assert coin_change([7], 50) == -1
from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 3, 4], 6); assert result == 2

tests.description: 算法正确性：需要组合多种面额
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([2, 5, 10], 14); assert result == 3

tests.description: 算法正确性：最优解验证
tests.code: from coin_change import coin_change; result = coin_change([1, 5, 10, 25], 67); assert result == 6
